channel.title: Willitboard: will your cabin bag fit?
channel.description: Cabin bag limits from each operator's official page, checked by a person.

item.title: easyJet cabin bag size and allowance
item.description: Will your bag fit easyJet's cabin limits? Type its size on Willitboard and see in seconds whether it goes at no extra cost, costs extra or doesn't fit. Taken from easyJet's official page and checked by a person, with the date shown on the page.
